_comment: Third-party tools kept from the source list. Nothing here is installed by default: ./install --external opens a menu; ./install --external <name> installs one. Every entry is cloned/installed into ~/.fayah/external and scanned with SkillSpector where it contains skills or MCP config.

awesome-claude-code.why: Source for new skills, hooks and commands to vet and import into this library.

awesome-mcp-servers.why: Source for new MCP servers to add to mcp/servers.json.

claude-cookbooks.why: Worked examples for learning AI development (tool use, agents, evals).

claude-quickstarts.why: Starter apps to practise agent patterns; good kata bases.

superclaude.why: Personas and commands (analyze, improve, troubleshoot) that complement the review skills. Heavy; try before adopting.
superclaude.post: echo 'See README in ~/.fayah/external/superclaude for its installer (pipx/npm).'

claude-task-master.why: Turns a PRD/spec into a dependency-ordered task list; pairs with the manager-orchestration skill.

claude-swarm.why: Multi-agent orchestration with persistent memory (Ruby). Alternative to the built-in Agent tool for larger teams of agents.

claude-code-router.why: Route Claude Code requests to other model providers; useful for cheap sub-agent waves.

mcphub.why: Single gateway in front of many MCP servers once mcp/servers.json grows past a handful.

skillspector.why: Required commit gate: scans every skill, agent, command and MCP config in this repo. Installed by `make scan` if missing.

aider.why: Terminal pair-programmer; useful for comparing agent behaviours in mentoring sessions.

openhands.why: Autonomous agent platform (formerly OpenDevin). Reference implementation for agent architecture study.

dropped.claude-dev-tools (zebbern): Repo not found under that name; zebbern/claude-code-guide is a doc, link it from docs instead.
dropped.mcphub (idosal): Wrong owner in source list; replaced by samanhappy/mcphub.
dropped.continue, cline, open-interpreter: IDE/desktop agents outside the Claude Code workflow; install from their own sites if wanted.
dropped.claude-desktop-extensions: Only relevant if you ship Claude Desktop extensions; see anthropics/mcpb.
